decision: User accepts Invalidate+Compare Ada architecture as the starting baseline. No independent rediscovery of 16 ways is required before implementation.

geometry_provenance.capacity: Local RTX4000Ada device query and prior reuse evidence
geometry_provenance.ways: Paper section3.6, adopted by explicit user instruction
geometry_provenance.line_bytes: Paper plus existing local functional contract
geometry_provenance.sector_bytes: Existing local functional contract; not newly attributed to this paper
geometry_provenance.logical_slices: Fixed software organization informed by 20 observed LTS counter classes; not a paper physical parameter
geometry_provenance.set_index: Existing backend X / BitwiseXor surrogate, frozen for baseline comparisons; paper does not publish hardware hash

paper_policy_constraints.nominal_dirty_budget_status: Accepted initial hypothesis from paper 50 percent conjecture; seven and eight are history-dependent constraints, not static 7-way cache
paper_policy_constraints.mixed_priming: 7 stores + 9 loads occupy16 entries; shared entries, not rigid physical banks
paper_policy_constraints.load_insertion: Early replacement while not full must be representable; always prefer every invalid way is insufficient
paper_policy_constraints.full_load_and_pure_store_order: LRU behavior in paper specified histories
paper_policy_constraints.mixed_victim: Represent primary dirty victim plus possible additional least-recently-read victim from Fig6; do not generalize into always evict two

implementation.existing_backend: SectorLruCache with corrected non-power-of-two partition quotient/remainder and X set index
implementation.paper_policy_module: pending implementation; geometry config alone does not implement the history-dependent rules
implementation.multi_victim_interface: Current CacheAccess has one evicted member. Implement primary and additional victims as separate events before claiming Fig6 conformance.

validation_order: CPU structural parser and all-set/all-capacity reachability
software constraints derived from paper Fig6 and AppendixB
reuse existing measured full-sector write cohorts without geometry fitting
targeted hardware discriminator only for residual policy choices
same-parameter full-model acceptance when policy ready
claim_boundary: A fixed useful initial architecture adopted from literature, local evidence and explicit surrogate choices. Structural baseline acceptance is distinct from completed write-policy implementation or <5% hardware traffic acceptance.
